name: web-liquid-glass-quote-card-green-accent
title: Liquid-glass quote card with green accent word
whatItIs: A second variant of the jagged glass-panel quote card, this time with a green highlighted keyword and glass hexagonal prop shapes at its corners.
whatItMeans: Using one accent color inside otherwise white text draws the eye straight to the concept word, turning a quote into a one-glance takeaway.
techniques: highlight a single keyword in an accent color instead of styling the whole quote
vary the glass corner props (spheres, prisms) across a template set to keep a series feeling designed, not copy-pasted
keep the background grid identical across variants to build a recognizable template family

vocabulary.definition: a single distinct color used sparingly to draw attention within an otherwise neutral palette
